research_goal: Assess identifiability and goodness-of-fit of T1, T2, heteronuclear NOE using a physically dimensioned two-exponential spectral-density model, not reconstruct an interdomain 3D-angle ensemble.
spectral_density: J(omega)=(2/5)*(w*tau_fast/(1+(omega*tau_fast)^2)+(1-w)*tau_slow/(1+(omega*tau_slow)^2)). All tau in seconds and omega in radians/second.

acceptance.primary_fit: Use observed T1,T2 and their reported uncertainties only; predicted T1,T2 in ms both within two reported delta units (independent box tolerance, NOT 95pct confidence interval).
acceptance.out_of_sample_observable: For T1/T2-accepted grid points, count those whose predicted heteronuclear NOE is within 2 reported delta_NOE of measurement; no simultaneous NOE fitting in calibration.
acceptance.report: For each of 10 fixed real residues, accepted model counts and NOE prediction min/max; separately strict Rex=0 and Rex>=0 sensitivity.
acceptance.empty_grid: MODEL_MISMATCH_COARSE_GRID, do not estimate a parameter
acceptance.interpretation: Allowing Rex broadens flexibility and does not demonstrate chemical exchange. Multiple grid points are not an ensemble of interdomain angles.

next: Demand multiple magnetic fields, independently validated diffusion model and actual angular/distance restraint if precise domain orientation ensembles are requested.
